topic: cure act 2026 replaces ghmc act property tax capital value hyderabad
title: CURE Act replaces GHMC Act from October 2; property tax to be calculated on capital value
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — HYDERABAD
verified_by: The Hindu bureau report, article fetched and fact-matched 2026-10-02
bullets_en: GHMC Act 1955 is history: the CURE Act 2026 now governs three corporations.
Property tax shifts from rental value to capital value; some bills may double.
Residential tax is 0.1%-0.5% of capital value; commercial 0.2%-2%.
No transfer of properties with unauthorised constructions under the new law.
An Apex Governance Council chaired by the Chief Minister replaces council control.
bullets_ur: GHMC Act 1955 ki jagah ab CURE Act 2026 lagu hua, jo teen municipal corporations par amal karega.
Property tax ab annual rental value ke bajaye capital value par lagegi; kuch ki tax dogni ho sakti hai.
Residential property par 0.1% se 0.5% aur commercial par 0.2% se 2% tax lagaya jayega.
Nakli (unauthorised) construction wali properties ka transfer naye qanoon ke tehat manzoori nahi.
Ab tax mein barh CM ki sadasyat wali Apex Governance Council tay karegi.
